name: sgs/account
title: SGS Account
description: Wraps WooCommerce's My Account page: styled sidebar/tabs menu, a dashboard with a latest-order status card and quick-links, and side-by-side, stacked or tabbed logged-out log-in and register cards, and an optional signed-out card (Spec 27 Part 3, FR-30-14, FR-30-25).

fieldInput.label: Account form fields
fieldInput._note: WooCommerce's own log-in, register, lost-password, address and account-details inputs, selects and textareas, painted through includes/forms/field-own-style.php::field_own_style_css (the form's field* names) plus includes/account/helpers-account-field-css.php for padding, height, text colour and type.

fieldLabel.label: Account field labels
fieldLabel._note: The labels of WooCommerce's account forms. labelPosition above prints display:block and the label gap as margin-bottom; unset keeps WooCommerce's placement.

order-thumbs.label: Latest-order thumbnails row
order-thumbs._note: The latest-order thumbnails row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows.

order-actions.label: Latest-order links row
order-actions._note: The latest-order links row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows.

menuLink._note: WooCommerce's own menu markup: the links menuTextColour paints. The active link takes the menuActive colours, which beat hover, so the hoverable links are the others.
menuLink.label: Menu links

signed-out-actions.label: Signed-out card buttons row
signed-out-actions._note: The signed-out card's buttons row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows.

auth-tabs.label: Sign-in tab list
auth-tabs._note: The Sign in / Create account tab list (authLayout tabs): the space between the tabs and below them.

auth-tab.label: Sign-in tabs
auth-tab._note: Each tab takes the site's button presets for colour, radius, border and type; these are the height and the open tab's shadow.

signed-out-button.label: Signed-out card buttons
signed-out-button._note: The card's two buttons are rendered by sgs/button, which paints these three values; their colours, radius, type and hover come from the site's button presets.

signed-out-heading.label: Signed-out card heading
signed-out-heading._note: The card's own heading type settings; unset, the heading takes the block's shared heading look.

signedOutCopy.label: Signed-out card text
signedOutCopy._note: The signed-out card's paragraph. Its own type settings (signedOutCopy); unset, it takes the shared card-description look.

signedOutCard.label: Sign-in card
signedOutCard._note: The card a signed-out visitor sees when signedOutView is card, and the card holding the sign-in tabs when authLayout is tabs. Its shadow is the signedOutCardShadow family (ShadowControl).

cardTitle.label: Card titles
cardTitle._note: Card titles share the headings colour (headingColour); only their typography is separate.
cardTitle.absentWhy: The card titles, status chip and order progress track print only on the logged-in dashboard (includes/account/templates/dashboard.php); a visitor sees the login form and the tracking card.

chip.label: Status chip
chip.absentWhy: The card titles, status chip and order progress track print only on the logged-in dashboard (includes/account/templates/dashboard.php); a visitor sees the login form and the tracking card.

track.label: Progress track
track.absentWhy: The card titles, status chip and order progress track print only on the logged-in dashboard (includes/account/templates/dashboard.php); a visitor sees the login form and the tracking card.

contentLink._note: The links contentLinkColour paints: the account content's plain links, never the menu, buttons or quick cards.
contentLink.label: Content links

ordersRows.label: Order rows
ordersRows._note: The orders table drawn as bordered rows (ordersLook). The border colour paints the frame and the hairlines between rows.

loginButton.label: Form submit button
loginButton._note: The sign-in button; with loginButtonScope all-forms it is also the register, lost-password, account-details and address buttons. loginButtonPreset takes the site's button preset variables.

headerBlock.label: Page header
headerBlock._note: The page header (eyebrow, title, intro, signed-in line) as one motion part: the target of a header entrance.

authGrid.label: Sign-in and register forms
authGrid.absentWhy: The sign-in and register forms print for a signed-out visitor only.
authGrid._note: The two forms (sign in, register) as one motion part: the target of their entrance.

lostForm.label: Forgotten-password and new-password form
lostForm.absentWhy: The forgotten-password and new-password forms print for a signed-out visitor only.
lostForm._note: The form of the forgotten-password and new-password views as one motion part: the target of their entrance (the page header is its own part).

tabContent.label: Tab content
tabContent.absentWhy: The tab content prints for a signed-in customer only.
tabContent._note: The content of the open tab (orders, addresses, wishlist, account details) as one motion part: the target of a tab entrance.

fieldBackground.description: Ground of the account forms' text inputs, selects and textareas: a palette slug or colour. Unset = the stylesheet's surface colour.

fieldTextColour.description: Text colour typed into the account forms' fields. Unset = the stylesheet's text colour.

fieldPlaceholderColour.description: Placeholder colour of the account forms' fields. Unset = the browser's placeholder colour.

fieldBorderColour.description: Resting border colour of the account forms' fields, via --sgs-field-edge-colour so the focus ring still wins. Unset = the stylesheet's border colour.

fieldBorderWidth.description: Field border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Unset = the stylesheet's 1px.

fieldBorderStyle.description: Field border style. Unset = solid when a width is set.

fieldBorderRadius.description: Field corner radius per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Unset = the stylesheet's 6px.

fieldPadding.description: Field padding per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Unset = the stylesheet's 0.5rem 0.75rem.

fieldMinHeight.description: Minimum height of the account forms' single-line fields (inputs and selects), per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. The value is the height, even below 44px. Unset = 44px.

fieldShadow.description: Field shadow: a preset slug or a CSS box-shadow value. Unset = none.

fieldShadowColour.description: Field shadow colour. Unset = the preset's own colour.

labelColour.description: Colour of the account forms' field labels. Unset = the stylesheet's text colour.

labelPosition.description: Where a field's label sits. above = a block above the field with the label gap beneath it; unset = WooCommerce's own label placement.

labelGap.description: Space between a label and its field when the label sits above, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a spacing preset. Unset = WooCommerce's own spacing.

fieldFontSize.description: Font size of the field text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

fieldFontSizeUnit.description: Unit of the field font size.

fieldFontFamily.description: Font family of the field text.

fieldFontWeight.description: Font weight of the field text.

fieldFontStyle.description: Font style of the field text.

fieldLineHeight.description: Line height of the field text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

fieldLineHeightUnit.description: Unit of the field line height ('' = unitless).

fieldLetterSpacing.description: Letter spacing of the field text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

fieldLetterSpacingUnit.description: Unit of the field letter spacing.

fieldTextTransform.description: Text transform of the field text.

fieldTextDecoration.description: Text decoration of the field text.

labelFontSize.description: Font size of the label text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

labelFontSizeUnit.description: Unit of the label font size.

labelFontFamily.description: Font family of the label text.

labelFontWeight.description: Font weight of the label text.

labelFontStyle.description: Font style of the label text.

labelLineHeight.description: Line height of the label text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

labelLineHeightUnit.description: Unit of the label line height ('' = unitless).

labelLetterSpacing.description: Letter spacing of the label text per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}.

labelLetterSpacingUnit.description: Unit of the label letter spacing.

labelTextTransform.description: Text transform of the label text.

labelTextDecoration.description: Text decoration of the label text.

orderThumbsFlexWrap.description: Whether the product thumbnails on the latest-order card wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

orderActionsFlexWrap.description: Whether the View order and Track parcel links on the latest-order card wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

noOrdersText.default: You haven't placed an order yet.

guestLineText.default: No account? You can check out as a guest.

signedOutActionsFlexWrap.description: Whether the card's sign-in and create-account buttons wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Absent keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour (wrap).

menuActiveIndicatorColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the active menu item bar instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over menuActiveIndicatorColour at render time.

menuActiveBackgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the active menu item background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over menuActiveBackgroundColour at render time.

cardBackgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the card background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over cardBackgroundColour at render time.

headingMarginBottom.description: Space under each heading per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a spacing preset. Unset = 0.5rem.

headingColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the heading and card title text instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over headingColour at render time.

chipBackgroundColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the status chip background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over chipBackgroundColour at render time.

strings.description: Wording overrides: WooCommerce default string key to the client's string. Applied only while this block renders.

headerLostSentTitle.description: Title of the lost-password confirmation view. With this and the intro empty the confirmation keeps the request view's header and WooCommerce's own message.

headerLostResetTitle.description: Title of the choose-a-new-password view. With this and the intro empty it keeps the request view's header.

headerTitleTag.description: Heading level of the page header title. Unset = h2.

menuActiveIndicatorWidth.description: Width of the active menu item bar per device. Unset = 3px.

menuOrder.description: Endpoint keys in the order the menu shows them; endpoints not listed follow in their own order and Log out stays last. Unset = WooCommerce's order with Saved items after Orders.

tabHeadings.description: Print an H2 with the menu label at the top of the Orders, Addresses and Account details tabs. Unset = none.

wishlistLayout.description: How the Saved items tab draws the list: empty = the wishlist panel's own layout, cards = a three-column grid of frame cards (two on a phone) with a heart that removes.

wishlistCountText.description: Count beside the Saved items heading; {count} becomes the number of saved items, for example {count} frames. Empty = no count.

wishlistCountOneText.description: The count wording for exactly one saved item, for example {count} frame. Empty = the plural wording.

wishlistEmptyHeading.description: Heading of the Saved items card shown while the list is empty (same look as the orders empty card). Empty heading, text and button = the wishlist panel's own empty message.

addressSameText.description: The line in an empty billing card while a delivery address is saved. Empty = the empty-card line.

resetErrorsInline.description: Replaces WooCommerce's choose-a-new-password form so its validation errors print as text under the fields instead of a boxed notice above. Off = WooCommerce's own form.

addressEditor.description: Replaces WooCommerce's address list and address form with one card per address type, each editing inline and saving through WooCommerce's own handler. Off = WooCommerce's own screens.

addressEditLabel.description: Edit link on a card that has an address. Empty = "Edit {card title}".

addressAddLabel.description: Edit link on a card with no address. Empty = "Add {card title}".

addressSaveLabel.description: Save button of the inline address form. Empty = WooCommerce's own.

addressCancelLabel.description: Cancel link of the inline address form.

addressLine1Label.description: Label and placeholder of the first address line, for example Address. Empty = WooCommerce's own label.

addressCityLabel.description: Label and placeholder of the town field, for example Town or city. Empty = WooCommerce's own label.

addressLine2Label.description: Label and placeholder of the second address line, for example Flat / building. Empty = WooCommerce's own label.

addressPairs.description: Comma-separated field names (city, postcode) that sit side by side in the inline form; first and last name already do.

addressHideFields.description: Comma-separated optional field names (company, state) left out of the inline form; their saved value is kept. A required field is kept as a hidden value, and the billing email falls back to the account email.

addressEmptyText.description: The line in an address card with nothing saved; {type} becomes the card's title without the word address (delivery, billing). Empty = WooCommerce's own line.

accountFormColumns.description: Columns of the account details fields. Unset = WooCommerce default.

accountMobileHint.description: A line under the Mobile field. Empty = none.

loginButtonPreset.description: Takes the site's button preset for the form submit button. Unset = WooCommerce's button.

registerButtonPreset.description: Takes the site's button preset for the register form's submit button. Unset = WooCommerce's button.

loginButtonScope.description: Unset = the sign-in button only. all-forms = also register, lost password, account details and address save.

loginLinkPlacement.description: Where the lost-password link sits. Unset = WooCommerce default (its own line).
